item.title: 2026 North Peace People’s Choice Awards
item.description: What does it feel like to win a North Peace People’s Choice Award? Past recipients are sharing their experiences and what this recognition meant to them and their businesses. The RE/MAX North Peace People’s Choice Awards are about more than a title; they’re about celebrating the people, places, and businesses that make our community thrive. Now it’s your turn to show your support! Vote for your favourite person, place, or business at northpeaceawards.com and help spotlight the best of the North
